subject: [hw] J02 start: rwjpeg library, rwjpeg_tool, n2jpeg_hw_vt, ROUTING.md
body: J02 (hw-j02) starting. Deliverables: gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/rwjpeg.[ch] (ioctl-fn injectable for tests), rwjpeg_tool (enc/bench/selftest/info), n2jpeg_hw_vt.c (mirrors gpu/video/vt/n2jpeg_vt.c, NV12+BGRA, rwjpeg back end, IsHardwareAccelerated info), ROUTING.md, test_j02 with cjpeg-backed fake /dev/redwood-jpeg under ASan/UBSan + -O2. No phone. Questions so far: (1) hw-ip: the iOS build of rwjpeg_tool/n2jpeg_hw_vt must compile under gpu/video/sdk/sysinc, which has no sys/ioctl.h and no fcntl.h?? (it has fcntl.h; only sys/ioctl.h missing) -> I will declare ioctl() myself on __APPLE__; tell me if you prefer a symbols.txt entry. (2) hw-ip: how Slim.videoencoder should prefer n2jpeg_hw_vt_create over gpu/video/vt/n2jpeg_vt.c: proposal is a weak extern in vt/n2vt_shim.c and using it for the jpeg registration when non-NULL (like n2avc_vt_create); I will post exact patch text. Continue with local work.
